01 / Problem → Solution

Cloud AI breaks confidentiality. Local AI fixes it.

Freelancers handle sensitive client data — contracts, budgets, payment records — using cloud-based AI tools that send this information to third-party servers. Solo Worker OS keeps everything on your machine.

The Problem
Cloud APIs = Data Leaves Your Machine

Every message to a cloud LLM API sends client data through third-party servers. For lawyers, accountants, and consultants, this violates professional confidentiality obligations.

  • Client names, contacts, and budgets exposed
  • Contract terms and deadlines sent to cloud
  • Invoice amounts and payment records leaked
  • Zero control over data retention by API providers
The Solution
AGENT_PROVIDER=local

One environment variable switches the entire agent backend from cloud API to local inference on AMD Radeon GPU. All business data stays on your machine — zero cloud dependency.

  • vLLM / SGLang runs Qwen3 on AMD ROCm
  • 14 business tools work unchanged locally
  • Dual-backend memory: Supabase + local JSONL
  • Health monitoring via /api/local-llm/status

04 / AMD GPU Integration

Local Deployment on AMD Radeon GPU

The entire agent backend switches from cloud API to local inference with one environment variable. vLLM and SGLang both expose OpenAI-compatible endpoints, so agent logic remains unchanged.

Local LLM Provider

OpenAI-compatible interface connects to local vLLM/SGLang. Model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B. Default endpoint: localhost:8000/v1/chat/completions. API key defaults to EMPTY per vLLM convention.

ROCm Software Stack

Runs on AMD ROCm 6.2+ with Radeon GPU. Docker image: rocm/vllm-dev:rocm6.2. PagedAttention + continuous batching for optimized throughput.

Persistent Memory

Dual-backend MemoryStore: Supabase for cloud, local JSONL for air-gapped deployment. Conversations persist across sessions with conversation_id tracking.

Health Monitoring

Built-in /api/local-llm/status probes local inference service — checks reachability, model availability, and response latency. Settings page shows real-time GPU status.

Inference Optimization

SGLang + ATOM framework: 1100+ tok/s/gpu on MI355X. Qwen3-8B selected for optimal throughput-latency balance on single Radeon GPU. RadixAttention reuses KV cache.

Zero Code Changes

Local provider reuses existing openai-compat.ts layer. All 14 tools, streaming, function calling, and trace observability work unchanged in local mode.
